item.title: Robert Kyncl tells WMG shareholders: AI is music’s next growth engine, not its downfall
item.description: Warner boss also signals major pricing opportunity ahead for rightsholders on DSPs Source

item.title: Damon Whiteside to step down as Academy of Country Music CEO
item.description: Whiteside will remain as CEO Emeritus for the remainder of 2026 as the organization searches for his successor. Source

item.title: Sony sued by Lit, the band behind pop-punk hit ‘My Own Worst Enemy,’ over alleged unpaid streaming royalties
item.description: The group claims Sony has been using the wrong royalty formula for their streams. Source

item.title: Create Music Group, at $2.2 billion valuation, completes $450 million fundraise
item.description: The company remains majority-owned by its founders, with institutional investors Ares Management, 2 Mile, and Flexpoint Ford each holding minority stakes. Source

item.title: Michael Riggs promoted to SVP, Licensing & Income Tracking at Sony Music Publishing
item.description: Nashville-based executive expands oversight of digital licensing and royalty tracking operations as publisher continues broader leadership reshuffle. Source

item.title: Charlie Puth joins AI music creation platform Moises as Chief Music Officer
item.description: The Grammy-nominated songwriter and producer will help guide Moises' creative and product direction Source

item.title: As Live Nation antitrust trial begins, DOJ tells jury the concert industry is ‘broken’
item.description: The landmark trial will test whether Live Nation illegally monopolized the concert industry Source

item.title: Apple Music launches AI transparency tags — but only if labels and distributors declare them
item.description: The move was announced in a newsletter distributed to industry partners this morning (March 4). Source

item.title: Reservoir confirms receipt of unsolicited takeover approach from activist investor Irenic Capital
item.description: Irenic holds approximately 9.2% of the company's equity, according to a recent SEC filing Source

item.title: South Korea’s music industry unites to declare ‘war’ on AI copyright infringement
item.description: Six music rights organizations have formed a coalition, declaring a "state of emergency" and making what they describe as a "declaration of war" against AI copyright infringement. Source
